hook: 104 miles out, the fishing master needed a hospital.
narration: A hundred and four miles out in the Gulf, this boat's fishing master needed a hospital.
His crew stood by on deck as the helicopter came over.
A Coast Guard Jayhawk crew from Air Station Clearwater lowered the basket and brought him up.
The basket hangs on a steel cable from a hoist above the door, and the flight mechanic controls every foot of it.
outcome: And the Jayhawk crew flew him to Tampa General Hospital.

location_card.place: 104 miles west of Fort Myers, Florida

title: Hoisted 104 miles off Fort Myers
description:
On Aug. 27, 2019, a Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater MH-60 Jayhawk crew hoisted a fishing master from a fishing vessel 104 miles west of Fort Myers, Florida, and flew him to Tampa General Hospital.
